// diagnostic

E1218

Publishing `{new}` after `{old}` is a {bump} bump but breaks the public API item `{item}`.

What

Publishing `{new}` after `{old}` is a {bump} bump but breaks the public API item `{item}`.

Why

A {bump} bump promises callers no breaking changes under SemVer, but the public API changed since `{old}`. This is the local publish-time gate; the registry re-checks live with E2601 on receipt.

Fix

Bump to `{next_major}.0.0` (a major release), or restore `{item}` (a deprecated shim counts). Use `--force` to publish anyway with an explicit warning banner.
